page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it means
steps.why: Apis is the genus name of the honey bee, which is where the word apiculture comes from. The scientific name of a honey bee is a two-part name that begins with Apis.
common_mistakes: Confusing apiculture with sericulture or pisciculture.
steps.memory_tip: Apis is the bee, so apiculture is bee keeping.

steps.label: What it involves
steps.why: The hives are maintained so that honey and wax can be taken regularly without destroying the colony.
common_mistakes: Naming only honey. Wax is also produced.
steps.memory_tip: Keep hives for honey and wax.

lines.text: It is maintaining bee-hives for honey and wax

insider_note: Two marks for two lines: the one-word meaning, and what is actually kept and why.
